title: REQ · Existing Phaser code compiles and runs on 3.90
summary: createGame, config, BootScene and PhaserHost work against 3.90 types and APIs
description: Context: src/phaser/createGame.ts, config.ts, BootScene.ts and components/PhaserHost.tsx use Phaser.Game, Phaser.AUTO, Phaser.Scale.FIT, Phaser.Scene and Phaser.Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN, all present in 3.90. Desired behavior: these files type-check and their tests pass on 3.90 without Phaser 4-only APIs. Expected result: tsc passes and the phaser tests are green. Why: the pin must not break the app.
acceptance_criteria: Given Phaser 3.90 installed, When tsc --noEmit runs, Then it exits 0
Given the src/phaser modules, When scanned, Then they reference only Phaser APIs that exist in 3.90

preserve: Public signatures of createGame, buildGameConfig, BootScene
